rule.message: Students interested in pursuing a degree in computer engineering or electrical engineering are encouraged to take EE 1001 in their first year. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

All degree-seeking students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements .
All freshmen in the College of Science & Engineering must complete CSE 1001: First-Year Experience.
At least 26 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
View Four-year Plans for the College of Science and Engineering. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Integrated Bachelor of Electrical Eng/Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Eng., Integrated Bachelor of Electrical Engineering/Master of Science in Robotics. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
